en.name: MedBridge Innovation Award
en.description: A corporate challenge connecting Latin American health and biotech companies with China's healthcare distribution and co-development market.
en.detailSubtitle: Built for ventures that need sharper positioning, partner alignment, and a realistic market-development path into China's healthcare ecosystem.
en.metaTitle: MedBridge Innovation Award | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Review the MedBridge Innovation Award for biotech and healthtech companies entering China.
en.overviewHtml: MedBridge Innovation Award focuses on the operational side of healthcare market entry: partner fit, clinical relevance, and commercialization logic.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Healthtech and biotech companies with a validated solution.
  • Teams pursuing channel development, co-development, or distribution in China.
  • Operators able to explain regulatory and commercial readiness.
en.supportHtml:
• Sector-specific introductions and narrative review.
  • Support refining competition materials for healthcare audiences.
  • Clearer preparation for investor, operator, and partner conversations.
en.processHtml:
1. Apply through the unified competition form.
  2. Upload the main deck and any regulatory or product context that matters.
  3. Work with the team on final packaging and submission readiness.

br.name: MedBridge Innovation Award
br.description: Um desafio corporativo que conecta empresas LATAM de health e biotech ao mercado chines de distribuicao e co-desenvolvimento em saude.
br.detailSubtitle: Feito para ventures que precisam de melhor posicionamento, alinhamento com parceiros e uma rota realista de desenvolvimento de mercado no ecossistema chines de saude.
br.metaTitle: MedBridge Innovation Award | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Veja o MedBridge Innovation Award para empresas de biotech e healthtech que querem entrar na China.
br.overviewHtml: O MedBridge Innovation Award foca no lado operacional da entrada em saude: aderencia a parceiros, relevancia clinica e logica de comercializacao.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Empresas de healthtech e biotech com solucao validada.
  • Times buscando desenvolvimento de canal, co-desenvolvimento ou distribuicao na China.
  • Operadores capazes de explicar prontidao regulatoria e comercial.
br.supportHtml:
• Introducoes setoriais e revisao da narrativa.
  • Apoio para refinar materiais da competicao para audiencias de saude.
  • Preparacao mais clara para conversas com investidores, operadores e parceiros.
br.processHtml:
1. Aplique pelo formulario unificado.
  2. Envie deck principal e qualquer contexto regulatorio ou de produto relevante.
  3. Trabalhe com a equipe na embalagem final e prontidao de submissao.

cn.name: MedBridge Innovation Award
cn.description: 连接拉美健康科技与生物科技企业和中国医疗分销及联合开发市场的企业挑战赛。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合需要更强定位、合作伙伴匹配和现实市场开发路径的健康科技与生物科技团队。
cn.metaTitle: MedBridge Innovation Award | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 查看 MedBridge Innovation Award，适合准备进入中国市场的健康科技与生物科技公司。
cn.overviewHtml: MedBridge Innovation Award 聚焦医疗市场进入的运营层面，包括伙伴适配、临床相关性和商业化逻辑。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 拥有已验证解决方案的健康科技和生物科技公司。
  • 寻求渠道建设、联合开发或中国分销机会的团队。
  • 能够说明监管与商业准备度的运营者。
cn.supportHtml:
• 行业引荐和叙事审阅支持。
  • 帮助面向医疗受众优化竞赛材料。
  • 更清晰地准备投资人、运营方和伙伴沟通。
cn.processHtml:
1. 通过统一竞赛申请表提交。
  2. 上传主演示文档以及相关监管或产品背景材料。
  3. 与团队共同完善最终包装和提交准备。
